user.title: Sign in to Cello
user.description: Enter the phone number of your Cello account. Cello will text you a sign-in code.

code.title: SMS code
code.description: Enter the code Cello sent to {phone}.

error.invalid_phone: That does not look like a phone number.
error.cannot_send_code: Cello did not send a code. Check the number.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That code belongs to a different account.

menu_options.pick_car: A car: location, drive detection and alerts

data.reminder_minutes: Remind when a parking has run this long (0 = off)
data.renew_before_minutes: Auto-renew this long before Cello's end time

car.title: Car {car}
car.description: Where the car is and when it drives away. Leave the device empty for automatic: the phone nearest the spot where the parking was started stands in for the car, and its activity sensor (Automotive) tells driving.

data.tracker: Device on the car (dashcam / tracker / person)
data.tracker_backup: Backup device (used while the first one has no position)
data.drive_entity: Drive signal (ignition, dashcam state…; on / driving = driving)
data.move_meters: Moved this far from the parking spot = drove away

start_parking.name: Start parking
start_parking.description: Start a Cello parking for a car. Without city/zone it uses the car's Parking zone choice.

hours.name: Hours
hours.description: Let Cello end the parking after this many hours. 0 = until stopped. Defaults to the car's Park for value.

until.name: Until
until.description: Let Cello end the parking at this time.

accept_message.name: Accept Cello's message
accept_message.description: If Cello asks to confirm (for example free parking now), accept it without asking.

stop_parking.name: Stop parking
stop_parking.description: Stop the car's running Cello parking.

extend_parking.name: Extend parking
extend_parking.description: Extend the car's running Cello parking.

accept_message.name: Accept Cello's message
accept_message.description: Accept Cello's confirmation message if it asks.

find_zones.name: Find zones
find_zones.description: List the Cello cities and zones at a location.
